title: Iran to Hold First Gulf Talks Since War Began — Foreign Ministers to Meet in Oman Monday Over Strait of Hormuz
detail: Iran's Foreign Ministry announced Friday that Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi will meet Gulf Cooperation Council counterparts and Iraq in Salalah, Oman on Monday, Sept 14, to discuss management of the Strait of Hormuz — the first such gathering between Iran and Gulf Arab states since the war began Feb 28. Oman, which has brokered prior Iran-Gulf de-escalation steps including the Aug 26 temporary joint navigation corridor, said the talks are 'intended to promote better understanding among the countries of the region and help strengthen shared regional security.' Iran currently requires vessels to obtain permits to transit the strait and has floated a service-fee mechanism; the waterway normally carries about one-fifth of global oil supply.

media.caption: Iran announces first Gulf talks on the Strait of Hormuz since the war began, Sept 11, 2026

confidenceReason: Direct on-record announcement from Iran's Foreign Ministry, corroborated by Arab News and Bloomberg reporting on the Oman-brokered meeting; whether the talks actually yield a breakthrough remains unconfirmed pending Monday's meeting.

title: Trump Links 25th 9/11 Anniversary to Iran War at Pentagon Ceremony: 'That's Why We Fight Today'
detail: At a Pentagon ceremony marking the 25th anniversary of the September 11, 2001 attacks, President Trump directly tied the commemoration to the ongoing war with Iran: 'Today we renew the sacred oath that we first swore in their names a quarter of a century ago. We will never, ever forget. That's why we fight today.' He said the US would ensure 'the world's number one sponsor of terror — the Islamic Republic of Iran — will never ever have a nuclear weapon.' Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, speaking alongside Trump, claimed US forces have killed Iranian military leaders, destroyed Iran's air force, dismantled its defenses over six months of fighting, and now control the Strait of Hormuz — an assessment independent analysis (Al-Monitor) disputes, noting the war has 'slid into a stalemate with Iran largely maintaining its grip on the Strait of Hormuz, and keeping oil prices high.' Trump had sought to speak at the National September 11 Memorial and Museum in New York but was declined to preserve the event's nonpartisan character.

media.caption: President Trump at the Pentagon's 9/11 anniversary ceremony, Sept 11, 2026

confidenceReason: Direct on-record presidential and cabinet remarks corroborated across Times of Israel and Al-Monitor reporting; Hegseth's claim of 'controlling' the Strait of Hormuz is a contested assessment, not a verified fact.
